arguments.value: This agreement is a strategic alliance between Cool Technologies Inc. and Veteran Technology Group, LLC. The two companies agree to refer business to each other and separately market and perform their own services: Cool Technologies Inc. provides its Mobile Generation program and related services, and Veteran Technology Group, LLC provides business management consulting, GAIT software, and other AI services. Each company controls its own pricing, staffing, scheduling, and client approvals for the work it performs, and each keeps ownership of its own trademarks, copyrights, and other intellectual property. The agreement lasts at least five years, renews automatically for one-year terms unless properly terminated, and can also end earlier by mutual agreement or with 60 days’ written notice. The parties must keep confidential information private, may not solicit each other’s employees or contractors for six months after the agreement ends, and must indemnify each other for losses caused by their own negligence or willful misconduct. The agreement is governed by Missouri law.
